moment_definition: mu_1=m*(v_1x^2+v_1y^2)/(2B); normalize by that path initial mu_1
time_definition: shared normalized time, revealing original samples up to each frame time
exit_rule: Each curve and its endpoint marker stop at its own actual exit time. No hold or extrapolated trajectory beyond exit.

spatial_view.axis_scaling: 3D box is anisotropic: z visually compressed; x-z close projection has equal physical length aspect.
spatial_view.coordinate_units: normalized length, same physical coordinates as saved trajectories
spatial_view.head_rule: Last original saved sample at or before the common clock; no interpolation. Head disappears at exit; square marks the actual outgoing endpoint.
spatial_view.closest_rule: Star marks the closest saved trajectory sample only after its physical time; not a certified continuous minimum.

scope: Two individual12D zero-COM paths, not a COM-averaged ensemble, phase-converged integral, collision rate or lifetime.
